name: Tianjin Yiyi Hygiene Products Co.,Ltd
summary: Tianjin Yiyi Hygiene Products Co.,Ltd specializes in the research, production, and distribution of various hygiene solutions. The company's portfolio includes a range of products designed for pet care, alongside personal care items for humans, such as adult and baby care products, and feminine hygiene essentials. Operating from its headquarters in Tianjin, China, the firm was established in 2005 and serves both domestic Chinese and international markets.
